limitations: Wikipedia and the Drones of India project are secondary references. Their records are not official verification and snapshots may be stale.
This catalogue preserves all parseable source rows from the selected reference tables, including systems whose quantity is blank or ambiguous.
The same platform may appear in more than one source or service table; do not total records across sources.
Orders, proposed equipment, tests, under-construction platforms, and operational inventory are distinct lifecycle states.
No single public source provides a reconciled count of every Indian defence equipment type.
The ISRO count is a government-wide mixed civil/dual-use satellite aggregate, not a military-only or Defence Space Agency inventory.
